purpose: BreAK CRC-001 historical comparator benchmarks — KRAS-mut MSS CRC 1L FOLFOX±bevacizumab

benchmarks.os_floor_source: PRIME trial, FOLFOX4 monotherapy arm, RAS mutant (other) subgroup (KRAS exon 2 WT but KRAS exon 3/4 or NRAS exon 2/3/4 mutant), n=108, PMID 24024839
benchmarks.os_ceiling_source: PRIME trial, FOLFOX4 monotherapy arm, KRAS exon 2 mutant subgroup, n=~440, PMID 20921462
benchmarks.pfs_floor_source: PRIME trial, FOLFOX4 monotherapy arm, RAS mutant (other) subgroup, n=108, PMID 24024839
benchmarks.pfs_ceiling_source: PRIME trial, FOLFOX4 monotherapy arm, KRAS exon 2 mutant subgroup, n=~440, PMID 20921462
benchmarks.twelve_month_pfs_rate_source: Exponential model: 12mo_PFS = exp(-ln(2)/PFS_median × 12). Floor from RAS-other-mut PFS median 8.0 mo → 35.4%; ceiling from KRAS-exon2-mut PFS median 8.8 mo → 38.9%
benchmarks.primary_benchmark_note: PRIMARY BENCHMARK for BreAK CRC-001: KRAS exon 2 mutant FOLFOX4 arm OS 19.7 mo, PFS 8.8 mo (PRIME 2010, PMID 20921462). This is the dominant KRAS-mut MSS CRC population (~37% of all mCRC). SECONDARY REFERENCE: RAS-other-mutant FOLFOX4 arm OS 18.3 mo, PFS 8.0 mo (PRIME 2013, PMID 24024839) — this is KRAS exon 2 WT but other RAS mutant, a DIFFERENT population. The os_floor_months=18.3 and pfs_floor_months=8.0 represent the WORST-CASE across both RAS-mut subgroups, which is conservative and appropriate for a floor. However, the must-beat threshold should be anchored to the PRIMARY benchmark (KRAS exon 2 mut).

break_crc001_must_beat.rationale: 20% improvement over historical floor is a heuristic for single-arm Phase 1b/2 signal detection. Floor-based threshold (OS ≥22.0 mo) uses worst-case RAS-mut subgroup. Primary-benchmark-based threshold (OS ≥23.6 mo) uses KRAS exon 2 mutant arm — more stringent and more appropriate for BreAK CRC-001 target population. CAVEAT: Actual threshold depends on BreAK CRC-001 protocol primary endpoint and power calculation.
break_crc001_must_beat.bev_arm_os_ceiling_source: TRIBE trial, FOLFIRI+bev arm, RAS-mutation-positive subgroup OS 25.6 months (Cremolini 2015 Lancet Oncol, PMID 25038498); corroborated by BECOME mFOLFOX6+bev RAS-mut OS 25.7 months (Tang 2020 JCO) and community oncology KRAS-mut chemo+bev OS 26.9 months (Houts 2019 J Gastrointest Cancer)

subgroup_benchmarks.note: Adjuvant setting — not directly comparable to 1L mCRC but confirms KRAS-mut as worst-prognosis pMMR subgroup

bevacizumab_addback.source: TREE-2 trial (Hochster 2008 JCO, PMID 18235120): mFOLFOX6+bev OS 26.1 vs FOLFOX4 OS ~20 months in 1L mCRC
bevacizumab_addback.note: BreAK CRC-001 backbone is mFOLFOX6+/-bevacizumab — bevacizumab arm ceiling is ~2-3 months higher than FOLFOX alone

braf_v600e_benchmark.source: TRIBE updated analysis (Cremolini 2015 Lancet Oncol, PMID 25038498): BRAF-mutation-positive subgroup OS 13.4 months (HR 2.79 vs RAS/BRAF WT); CAPSTAN CRC real-world study (Martinelli 2022 ESMO Open, DOI 10.1016/j.esmoop.2022.100603): all 1L regimens BRAF-mut OS 12.9 months, PFS 6.0 months. PRIME trial (Douillard 2013 NEJM, PMID 24024839) confirmed BRAF mutation as strong negative prognostic factor but did not report BRAF V600E subgroup OS/PFS medians. BREAKWATER SOC arm (BRAF V600E, all-comers, chemo±bev): OS 15.1 months (Élez 2025 NEJM, DOI 10.1056/nejmoa2501912).
braf_v600e_benchmark.note: BRAF V600E is negative prognostic factor in PRIME; worst-prognosis subgroup in 1L FOLFOX. PRIME BRAF V600E subgroup medians not reported in abstract or primary publication — best available estimate from TRIBE BRAF-mut subgroup (OS 13.4 mo) and CAPSTAN CRC real-world (OS 12.9 mo, PFS 6.0 mo). BREAKWATER SOC arm (BRAF V600E, chemo±bev) OS 15.1 months represents upper bound for FOLFOX-based SOC in BRAF V600E. FOLFOX doublet alone (without bev) expected ~10-13 months based on CAPSTAN and real-world data.
braf_v600e_benchmark.prime_braf_subgroup_note: Exact PRIME FOLFOX4 arm BRAF V600E OS/PFS medians not published in primary paper or abstract; PRIME 2013 NEJM states BRAF mutation was strong negative prognostic factor (HR not reported for OS in BRAF subgroup in abstract). Supplementary Table S2 data not accessible via literature search.
braf_v600e_benchmark.primary_source_corrected: BREAKWATER SOC arm (BRAF V600E, chemo±bev, RCT, 2025): OS 15.1 mo — most recent and most directly relevant RCT benchmark. CAPSTAN CRC real-world OS 12.9 mo = floor. TRIBE 13.4 mo = supporting reference (FOLFOXIRI+bev vs FOLFIRI+bev, not FOLFOX4). TRIBE arms do not include FOLFOX4 monotherapy — TRIBE BRAF-mut OS is not FOLFOX4-specific.

kras_mut_folfox_bev_ceiling.source: TRIBE trial, FOLFIRI+bev arm, RAS-mutation-positive subgroup, OS 25.6 months (95% CI 22.4-28.6), Cremolini 2015 Lancet Oncol, PMID 25038498. Corroborated by: BECOME RCT mFOLFOX6+bev RAS-mut OS 25.7 months (Tang 2020 JCO, PMID 32453988, liver-limited only); community oncology KRAS-mut chemo+bev OS 26.9 months (Houts 2019 J Gastrointest Cancer, DOI 10.1007/s12029-017-0017-8); RAS/BRAF-mut mFOLFOX6+bev OS 22.6 months (Topal 2025 J Oncol Sci).
kras_mut_folfox_bev_ceiling.note: KRAS-mut specific OS ceiling for mFOLFOX6+bev arm. TRIBE FOLFIRI+bev RAS-mut subgroup OS 25.6 months is the most robust estimate from a randomized phase III trial. BECOME provides direct mFOLFOX6+bev RAS-mut data (25.7 months) but is liver-limited only. Consensus estimate: ~25-27 months for KRAS-mut 1L mFOLFOX6+bev all-comers.
kras_mut_folfox_bev_ceiling.caveat: IMPORTANT: 25.6 mo estimate is from TRIBE FOLFIRI+bev arm (not mFOLFOX6+bev). Direct mFOLFOX6+bev KRAS-mut data: BECOME 25.7 mo (liver-limited only, not generalizable). All-comers mFOLFOX6+bev KRAS-mut OS estimate: ~22-26 mo range. Use 25.6 mo as upper bound; 22-23 mo as conservative all-comers estimate.
